(ns alphafold.coordinator-server
  "HTTP API server for Clojure coordinator"
  (:require [org.httpkit.server :as http]
            [compojure.core :refer [defroutes GET POST]]
            [compojure.route :as route]
            [ring.middleware.json :refer [wrap-json-body wrap-json-response]]
            [ring.middleware.cors :refer [wrap-cors]]
            [alphafold.coordinator :as coord]
            [cheshire.core :as json]
            [taoensso.timbre :as log]))

(defroutes app-routes
  (POST "/api/jobs" {body :body}
    (let [{:keys [job_type params]} body
          result (coord/submit-job! job_type params)]
      {:status 200
       :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}
       :body result}))
  
  (GET "/api/jobs/:job-id" [job-id]
    (let [result (coord/get-job-status job-id)]
      {:status 200
       :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}
       :body result}))
  
  (GET "/api/health" []
    (let [result (coord/health-check)]
      {:status 200
       :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}
       :body result}))
  
  (GET "/api/metrics" []
    (let [result (coord/get-metrics)]
      {:status 200
       :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}
       :body result}))
  
  (route/not-found {:status 404 :body {:error "Not found"}}))

(def app
  (-> app-routes
      (wrap-json-body {:keywords? true})
      wrap-json-response
      (wrap-cors :access-control-allow-origin [#".*"]
                 :access-control-allow-methods [:get :post :put :delete])))

(defn start-server! [port]
  (log/info "Starting Coordinator HTTP server on port" port)
  (http/run-server app {:port port}))

(defn -main
  "Main entry point when running as standalone coordinator."
  [& args]
  (log/info "Starting AlphaFold3 Coordinator...")
  (coord/initialize-coordinator!)
  
  (log/info "Coordinator is running. Press Ctrl+C to stop.")
  
  (.addShutdownHook (Runtime/getRuntime)
                   (Thread. coord/shutdown-coordinator!))
  
  (start-server! 4000)
  
  (while true
    (Thread/sleep 1000)))

(ns alphafold.coordinator-server
  (:require [org.httpkit.server :as http]
            [compojure.core :refer [defroutes GET POST]]
            [compojure.route :as route]
            [ring.middleware.json :refer [wrap-json-body wrap-json-response]]
            [ring.middleware.cors :refer [wrap-cors]]
            [alphafold.coordinator :as coord]
            [cheshire.core :as json]
            [taoensso.timbre :as log])
  (:gen-class))

(defn wrap-exception-handler
  [handler]
  (fn [request]
    (try
      (handler request)
      (catch Exception e
        (log/error e "Kérésfeldolgozási hiba")
        {:status 500
         :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}
         :body {:error "Belső szerverhiba történt"}}))))

(defroutes app-routes
  (POST "/api/jobs" {body :body}
    (try
      (let [{:keys [job_type params]} body
            result (coord/submit-job! job_type params)]
        {:status 200
         :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}
         :body result})
      (catch Exception e
        (log/error e "Feladat beküldési hiba")
        {:status 400
         :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}
         :body {:error "Érvénytelen feladat paraméterek"}})))
  
  (GET "/api/jobs/:job-id" [job-id]
    (try
      (let [result (coord/get-job-status job-id)]
        (if result
          {:status 200
           :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}
           :body result}
          {:status 404
           :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}
           :body {:error "Feladat nem található"}}))
      (catch Exception e
        (log/error e "Feladat állapot lekérdezési hiba" {:job-id job-id})
        {:status 500
         :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}
         :body {:error "Feladat állapot lekérdezési hiba"}})))
  
  (GET "/api/health" []
    (try
      (let [result (coord/health-check)]
        {:status 200
         :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}
         :body result})
      (catch Exception e
        (log/error e "Egészségállapot ellenőrzési hiba")
        {:status 503
         :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}
         :body {:status "nem elérhető" :error "Egészségállapot ellenőrzési hiba"}})))
  
  (GET "/api/metrics" []
    (try
      (let [result (coord/get-metrics)]
        {:status 200
         :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}
         :body result})
      (catch Exception e
        (log/error e "Metrikák lekérdezési hiba")
        {:status 500
         :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}
         :body {:error "Metrikák lekérdezési hiba"}})))
  
  (route/not-found 
    {:status 404 
     :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}
     :body {:error "Az útvonal nem található"}}))

(def app
  (-> app-routes
      (wrap-json-body {:keywords? true :bigdecimals? true})
      wrap-json-response
      (wrap-cors :access-control-allow-origin [#".*"]
                 :access-control-allow-methods [:get :post :put :delete :options]
                 :access-control-allow-headers ["Content-Type" "Authorization" "Accept"])
      wrap-exception-handler))

(defonce server-instance (atom nil))

(defn start-server! [port]
  (when-not @server-instance
    (log/info "Koordinátor HTTP szerver indítása a" port "porton")
    (let [stop-fn (http/run-server app {:port port})]
      (reset! server-instance stop-fn)
      (log/info "Koordinátor HTTP szerver sikeresen elindult"))))

(defn stop-server! []
  (when @server-instance
    (log/info "Koordinátor HTTP szerver leállítása")
    (@server-instance :timeout 5000)
    (reset! server-instance nil)
    (log/info "Koordinátor HTTP szerver leállítva")))

(defn -main
  [& args]
  (log/info "AlphaFold3 Koordinátor indítása...")
  
  (let [port (if (first args)
               (Integer/parseInt (first args))
               (if-let [env-port (System/getenv "PORT")]
                 (Integer/parseInt env-port)
                 4000))]
    
    (try
      (coord/initialize-coordinator!)
      (log/info "Koordinátor inicializálás sikeres")
      
      (.addShutdownHook 
        (Runtime/getRuntime)
        (Thread. 
          (fn []
            (log/info "Leállítási folyamat megkezdése")
            (coord/shutdown-coordinator!)
            (stop-server!)
            (log/info "Leállítás befejezve"))))
      
      (start-server! port)
      (log/info "Koordinátor fut. Nyomja meg a Ctrl+C billentyűkombinációt a leállításhoz.")
      
      (while (not (Thread/interrupted))
        (Thread/sleep 1000))
      
      (catch InterruptedException e
        (log/info "Szerver megszakítva")
        (coord/shutdown-coordinator!)
        (stop-server!))
      (catch Exception e
        (log/error e "Kritikus hiba a koordinátor indítása során")
        (System/exit 1)))))
